utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word and remind folks to bring any tools or spare parts they can. I’ll also make sure everyone knows when and where the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—send it over when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and remind folks to bring sturdy gloves, a flashlight, and any other tools or spare parts they can spare. I’ll also make sure everyone knows it’s happening this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Gus
